description: This file defines an interface 'ThingSearchException' that serves as a marker or aggregator for exceptions related to the Search service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a constant for error code prefix used in error handling.

classes.name: ThingSearchException
classes.description: Interface representing a collection of exceptions thrown by the Search service in the Ditto framework.

methods.name: ERROR_CODE_PREFIX
methods.description: Constant string prefix for error codes related to the Search service.
